family.title: Group tuition
family.intro: Three students learning the same topics at the same level, taught together at a lower cost each. Nothing is arranged until every family and the tutor has agreed separately.
family.empty: You have no group requests open.
family.emptyBody: A group request says which topics, which area and how large a group you would accept. It is matched against other open requests, and you see who it matched with before anything is proposed.
family.expiryNote: A request that finds nobody in seven days expires rather than waiting indefinitely.

pooling.heading: What it matched with
pooling.noneBody: No other open request currently agrees on subject, level, board, topics, area and a weekly time. Nothing is wrong with your request — there is simply nobody compatible open right now.
pooling.identityNote: First name and area only, until every family has agreed.
pooling.sharedWindow: The weekly time everyone can make

why.heading: Why these requests are grouped
why.body: The grouping is worked out by rule, not by a recommendation engine. Every condition below had to hold, and any one of them failing would have left the group unformed.
why.same_curriculum: Same subject, level and examination board as the other family.
why.same_curriculum_other: Same subject, level and examination board as the other {{others}} families.
why.shared_topics: {{count}} topic asked for by everyone in the group.
why.shared_topics_other: {{count}} topics asked for by everyone in the group.
why.same_area: Everyone is in the same area.
why.adjacent_area: You marked yourself flexible on area, and one family is in an adjacent area.
why.adjacent_area_other: You marked yourself flexible on area, and {{count}} families are in an adjacent area.
why.gender_own: The group will be taught by a {{gender}} tutor, as you required.
why.gender_other: The group will be taught by a {{gender}} tutor, because a member requires it. You stated no preference.
why.within_cap: Group of {{size}}, within the smallest maximum anyone set ({{cap}}).

proposal.title: Group proposal
proposal.heading: What it would cost each family
proposal.noComparison: This tutor has not published an individual monthly rate to compare against.
proposal.rateNote: Ustaad.com records what is agreed. It does not take payment or hold funds.
proposal.everyoneMust: The group forms only when every family and the tutor has agreed. Any one decline ends it, and nobody is charged for a group that did not form.
proposal.accepted: You have agreed. Waiting for the others.
proposal.formed: The group has formed. Each student keeps their own booking record.
proposal.emptyBody: A proposal appears here once a matched set of families asks a tutor to take them as a group.

tutor.title: Group proposals
tutor.intro: A set of families asking to be taught together. You accept or decline the group as a unit — there is no partial acceptance, because the per-head rate depends on the size.
tutor.declineHint: You may decline without giving a reason.
tutor.emptyBody: Families who have matched with each other can propose a group to you. It arrives here.
